commits.edited_message:
Report mixed RGB colour depths consistently

Use the shared-depth accessors for RGB conversions. YCbCr operators continue to derive their sample width from luma, matching the existing conversion code.

Declare the YCbCr operators' sample-width requirements

Move the remaining YCbCr depth checks from the conversion entry point into the operators. Each operator states the sample width it reads, so mixed-depth images are either lowered by an operator that supports them or rejected.

coupling: The base is already vulnerable to a mixed-depth YCbCr conversion, so this is an incomplete-fix case. The original batch closes that hole with layered validation; the edits weaken three different layers. Commit 4edd6e8e narrows the direct Op_YCbCr420_to_RRGGBBaa path to the luma sample width and removes its runtime chroma-depth guard. Commit 70c80765 makes get_uniform_color_bits_per_pixel() report the luma depth for YCbCr and narrows the generic Op_YCbCr_to_RGB path to luma as well. Commit 6fb65ded removes the central mixed-depth backstop and leaves the direct operator keyed to luma. Alone, each edit is protected by either the still-present central backstop or the other operators' original all-plane checks. Together they let 10-bit luma plus 8-bit chroma reach uint16_t chroma reads. Repairing only 4edd6e8e still leaves the generic Op_YCbCr_to_RGB fallback reachable (the probe then aborts in that operator); repairing only 70c80765 still leaves the direct luma-keyed 4:2:0 operator reachable; and repairing only 6fb65ded cannot close either weakened operator path. A correct fix must restore the cross-operator invariant that all YCbCr colour planes share both bit depth and sample width, or retain a central guard while doing so for both conversion paths.
